method: Authorized browser SQL editor; explicit BEGIN TRANSACTION READ ONLY; metadata catalogs only; no application RPC or user/event rows
scopeNotes: Views do not have ordinary table RLS; assess owner, invoker options and exposed predicates.
Table grants alone do not prove execution of writes; no live mutation probes were made.
TRUNCATE ACL is dangerous and bypasses RLS if a SQL-capable API role can use it; no claim that REST exposes a truncate route.
No production wallet/user binding row invariants or dynamic A/B tests executed.
A body hash match proves exact body bytes only, not migration application history or safety.
